scope: Read-only coverage and design review. No renderer, collectors, source histories or deployed site changed. No visual or audio model review; models received code or written direction.
findings: 837 matches all recognized local records through September 29. Caller class does not control the local participation count; backend prefix does. This corrects the initial caller-attribution suspicion.

Current local backend prefix filter recognizes omen-, am4-, fx99-. 1,057 Gemini-backed dispatch records (683 gcp-gemini + 374 gcp-gemini-pro) are outside that local filter; Gemini also has no actor category/collector. These are calls, not proven unique tasks or launches.
2,569 offload records have no backend. They cannot honestly be assigned to local or Gemini without further evidence.

235 run records and 233 receipts exist in merged corpus. They can affect first-event/host bookkeeping, but do not have an independent counted/rendered run series. These are not 468 distinct benchmark experiments.

Local recognized total includes 88 deepagents observation records alongside 22,672 successful HEARTH dispatch records; cross-source job identity is not established, so do not call it a unique inference count.

Line totals are capped at 20,000 changed lines per commit. Current cut receipt reports 7,938,025 displayed vs 18,447,909 raw line changes across 87 capped commits. Neither measure is current lines of code. Files sums file-touch activity and filesystem births/updates, not unique files.

Antigravity conversation directories exist: Linux antigravity-cli has 62 .db files, Windows antigravity has 113 .db files; sidecars also exist. Filenames/extensions counted only; no database contents read or session totals inferred.
No mechnet name matched collected lineage names/paths. Name-only search cannot establish absence under another project name.
